{{short description|Biologist}}
'''Eliezer (Eduardo) Zeiger''' is a professor of biology. He has taught at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]]. In 1970, he received his doctorate degree in genetics from the [[University of California, Davis]].

Zeiger has published almost 100 scientific papers on the subjects of photothynsesis and the sensory transduction of internal and external signals in plant cells. He is co-author of the "Plant Physiology and Development" textbook published by [[Oxford University Press]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Professor Eliezer Zeiger|url=http://www.jct.ac.il/he/node/1017|website=www.jct.ac.il|accessdate=16 July 2017|language=he}}</ref> which is a widely used upper-division plant physiology textbook that has been translated into numerous languages and published in six editions.

Zeiger's research includes stomatal function and the transfer of genetic material in response to blue-light. In 1987 he compiled a book on stomatal function, published by Stanford University Press.<ref>{{cite book|last1=Zeiger|first1=Eduardo|last2=Farquhar|first2=G. D.|last3=Cowan|first3=I. R.|title=Stomatal Function|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=mp-aAAAAIAAJ|publisher=Stanford University Press|accessdate=16 July 2017|language=en|date=1987|isbn=9780804713474}}</ref> He has also researched the types of acclimatizations of stomata that are reflected by larger yields in commercial agriculture.<ref>{{cite web|title=Plant Physiology and Development; Angus Murphy - Oxford University Press|url=https://global.oup.com/ushe/product/plant-physiology-and-development-9781605352558?cc=il&lang=en&q=sinauer|website=global.oup.com|accessdate=16 July 2017|language=en}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Zeiger grew up in Northern Argentina. He is a professor emeritus at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Eduardo Zeiger|url=https://international.ucla.edu/lai/person/1178#.WOI-pflVm00|website=UCLA Latin American Institute|accessdate=3 April 2017}}</ref><ref name = "TSF2" /> He is founder and executive director of the Torah Science Foundation,<ref name=TSF2>{{cite web|title=The Torah Science Foundation|url=http://www.torahscience.org/zeiger.html|website=Founders of the Torah Science Foundation|accessdate=3 April 2017}}</ref> which was founded for the purpose of integrating Torah wisdom and the wisdom of secular sciences.<ref name="TSF1">{{cite web|title=About the Torah Science Foundation|url=http://torahscience.org/about.html|website=The Torah Science Foundation|accessdate=3 April 2017}}</ref>

Since 1992, Zeiger has been a student of Rabbi [[Yitzchak Ginsburgh]], a leading authority on Jewish mysticism.<ref name="tolife">{{cite book|author1=Yitzchak Ginsburgh|author2=Eliezer Zeiger|title=The Torah of Life|url=http://torahscience.org/TSF_TorahBioBook_Pilot2_Combo_051514_Mark.pdf|accessdate=3 April 2017}}</ref> Together, Ginsburgh and Zeiger have co-authored part of a series of integrative Torah biology textbooks for Jewish high schools on nutrition and the nervous system.
